  • Nested Class Summary

    Nested Classes
    Modifier and Type
    Interface
    Description
    static final class 
    LogEncoder.Buffer.DirectByteBufferBuffer
    A buffer that formats into a reused StringBuilder (like LogEncoder.Buffer.StringBuilderBuffer) but encodes directly into a reused ByteBuffer via a CharsetEncoder, instead of going through an intermediate String and byte[] the way LogOutput.write(LogEvent, String)'s default implementation does.
    static final class 
    LogEncoder.Buffer.StringBuilderBuffer
    A buffer that simply wraps a StringBuilder.

  • Method Details

    • drain

      void drain(LogOutput output, LogEvent event)
      The appender will call this usually within a lock to transfer content from the buffer to the output.
      Parameters:
      output - output to receive content.
      event - log event.

    • clear

      void clear()
      Prepare the buffer for reuse.

      An appender may not call clear before being passed to the encoder so the encoder should do its own clearing.
